$comment: Phase 10 — PDFs we did not make. Fetched by `npm run fetch-real` into tmp/,
which is gitignored: the manifest is committed, the binaries never are.
`covers` maps to the case table in NEXT.md. Anything you drop into tmp/real/
by hand is picked up by the probe too, manifest or not.

files.name: freeculture.pdf
files.why: 352 pages, Type0/CID fonts, DCTDecode and CCITTFaxDecode images, linearised. A real published book — the single most useful file here.

files.name: issue3188.pdf
files.why: 7.9 MB on a single page of DCTDecode. The memory case for PDF-to-JPG at 3x.

files.name: 22060_A1_01_Plans.pdf
files.why: 6 MB single-page scanned plans, a different producer from issue3188.

files.name: issue12841_reduced.pdf
files.why: 5.7 MB single page. Third large-image producer.

files.name: cidfont_cmap_overflow.pdf
files.why: A CMap large enough to have broken pdf.js once.

files.name: ArabicCIDTrueType.pdf
files.why: Right-to-left script in an embedded CID TrueType — the case 9.2's WinAnsi work says nothing about.

files.name: issue19971.pdf
files.why: 6 pages mixing CID fonts and JPEG. Closest thing here to an ordinary modern document.

files.name: comments.pdf
files.why: 14 pages carrying comment annotations. Annotations are the neighbours of the form widgets 10.1 is about, so worth watching through copyPages.

files.name: images.pdf
files.why: A page of many images rather than one big one.

files.name: form_two_pages.pdf
files.why: A second real AcroForm, so 10.1's finding rests on more than one file we did not write.

files.name: empty_protected.pdf
files.why: Encrypted. pdf-lib throws a *parse* error on it rather than a password error, even with ignoreEncryption.

files.name: encrypted-attachment.pdf
files.why: Encrypted but readable with ignoreEncryption — the opposite half of 10.5 from empty_protected.

files.name: Brotli-Prototype-FileA.pdf
files.why: Not encrypted, and pdf-lib still cannot parse it. Our error path says 'password-protected or damaged' — this is the file that tests the second half of that sentence.

files.name: pdfa-1b-pass.pdf
files.why: A conforming PDF/A-1b file from veraPDF's own suite.
